description.narrative: Pakistan Telecommunications Company Ltd. (PTCL or the Company) has entered into a Share Purchase Agreement with Telenor Pakistan B.V. dated 14 December 2023 for the acquisition of 100% shares of Telenor Pakistan Private Ltd. (TPL) at a purchase price of PKR 108 billion on a cash free debt free basis. IFC plans to provide a loan of up to US$150 million and mobilize up to US$250 million in debt to fund PTCLs acquisition of TPL (the Project).

The Project is expected to result in increased access to reliable digital connectivity for individuals and businesses through a CapEx program supported by synergies generated by the ultimate merger between two telecom operators with large complementary networks and operations. The transaction is supporting the consolidation of the mobile market thereby unlocking cost synergies and economies of scale that would allow the Company to increase investment in digital infrastructure and enhance access to connectivity. The investment in digital infrastructure is expected to have a multiplier impact with other market players also being forced to improve access to connectivity through business model innovation and technology.
